cohort: Children in Yorkshire, United Kingdom, born between 1993-1994
finding: The mother's school-leaving age and rhesus factor were not associated with childhood type 1 diabetes, but having at least one amniocentesis procedure and, to a lesser extent, birth by cesarean delivery were associated with an increased probability of the child developing the disease.
mod_finding: Birth by cesarean delivery was associated with an increased probability of childhood type 1 diabetes.
